exercises.title: Complex Workflow with Error Handling
exercises.description: Build a multi-step workflow with error recovery.
instructions: Create keyword 'Initialize System' that logs 'System initialized'
Create keyword 'Process Data' that may fail
Wrap Process Data in TRY-EXCEPT block
In EXCEPT, log 'Error handled, continuing'
Create keyword 'Cleanup' that logs 'Cleanup done'
Test should: initialize, try to process (handle errors), cleanup

# Add workflow with error handling

*** Keywords ***

exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Robust Workflow
    Initialize System
    TRY
        Process Data
    EXCEPT
        Log    Error handled, continuing
    END
    Cleanup

*** Keywords ***
Initialize System
    Log    System initialized

Process Data
    Log    Processing data

Cleanup
    Log    Cleanup done
hints: Cleanup runs even if error occurs

exercises.title: Conditional Workflow
exercises.description: Create workflow that branches based on conditions.
instructions: Create ${mode} with value 'production'
IF ${mode} == 'production', log 'Running in production mode'
ELSE IF ${mode} == 'test', log 'Running in test mode'
ELSE log 'Running in development mode'
After IF, log 'Workflow completed'
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Conditional Workflow
    # Write code
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Conditional Workflow
    ${mode}    Set Variable    production
    IF    '${mode}' == 'production'
        Log    Running in production mode
    ELSE IF    '${mode}' == 'test'
        Log    Running in test mode
    ELSE
        Log    Running in development mode
    END
    Log    Workflow completed
hints: Real apps often have environment-specific logic

exercises.title: State Machine Pattern
instructions: Create ${state} with value 'idle'
Create keyword 'Transition' with [Arguments] ${from_state} ${to_state}
It verifies current state matches ${from_state}, then changes to ${to_state}
Test: idle -> running -> completed
Use WHILE loop or multiple IF checks
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add state machine test

*** Keywords ***
# Add transition keyword
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
State Machine
    ${state}    Set Variable    idle
    IF    '${state}' == 'idle'
        ${state}    Set Variable    running
        Log    Transitioned to running
    END
    IF    '${state}' == 'running'
        ${state}    Set Variable    completed
        Log    Transitioned to completed
    END
    Should Be Equal    ${state}    completed
